source: That encoding uniquely identifies the token, but it does not make two related tokens close. “cat” and “dog” are as orthogonal as “cat” and “compiler.” A learned dense representation instead gives each item a vector in a much smaller spaceZXMATH0000XZ withZXMATH0001XZ in many models.
zh: 该编码唯一地标识该令牌，但它不会使两个相关令牌接近。 “cat”和“dog”就像“cat”和“compiler”一样正交。相反，学习的密集表示在更小的空间中为每个项目提供一个向量ZXMATH0000XZ，在许多模型中为ZXMATH0001XZ。
